Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1223 PM EST Wed Nov 18 2026
 

- Dry weather during the week with above normal temperatures.

- Next chance for precipitation arrives this weekend with a cold
  frontal passage.

&&

.AVIATION...

The SE Mi terminal corridor is between mid Atlantic surface high 
pressure and northern Plains low pressure this afternoon and 
tonight. This maintains VFR under increasing SW wind that supplies 
mild air into the Great Lakes that is dry enough to limit clouds 
below 10 kft. Wind speed holds more in the 5 to 10 kt range and from 
the SW late tonight which also limits potential for visibility 
restriction outside of some light haze around sunrise. 

Northern Plains low pressure moves into northern Ontario during 
Thursday. This track pulls a moderate moisture axis into Lower Mi 
ahead of the trailing Midwest cold front. Resulting bands of clouds 
bring broken ceiling but still VFR which leaves SW wind gusting near 
30 knots as the weather highlight through Thursday afternoon.  

For DTW... No concerns with regard to DTW specific thresholds until 
later Thursday morning when bands of clouds have a chance to drop 
ceiling toward 5000 ft. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for ceiling 5000 feet or less Thursday.
